mode_family_line: family: flow-chains | evidence: 6 nodes and 6 relations (E = N, one relation per node), shallow depth, and the source asks for slow sparse motion on the traffic, so one dot per animated hop at the constant default speed.

budget.note: All three candidates are counted, including the synthetic-geometry engine probe and the lr orientation probe of the case content. Every candidate's raw --check output is preserved next to its spec.

views.carries: whole pipeline: 6 nodes, 6 relations, 4 labels, one dot per hop

attempts.kind: engine probe (synthetic ids/labels matched to the case's label widths, 3 sibling groups)
attempts.note: Probed whether declared sibling tier groups render as regions that contain their members in a centred 5-rank chain. They do not: --check reported extent=87x15 with groups tier-one(2) tier-two(3) tier-three(1), and the frames show the band borders landing in blank space away from the member boxes (region 'tier-one' border on rows 21/24 col 22..45 while its members AAA/BBBBBBBBBBB sit on rows 17). Rejected: shipping these boxes would draw false regions. Group declaration therefore dropped from the final spec.

attempts.kind: case content, direction tb, full source labels, no groups
attempts.note: Accepted. extent=31x46, crossings 0, labels 4/4 with 0 ambiguous owners, 6 single-dot routes at 0.5c/step, origins 6/6, no warnings. Fits the 77x47 target with no 'graph overflows' badge (evidence/v1/v1-77x47-frames.txt line 2 is the viewport line, no badge anywhere in the dump).

attempts.kind: orientation probe of the same case content, direction lr (the flow-chains recipe's nominal choice for 5+ ranks)
attempts.note: Rejected. extent=89x9 cells, i.e. 12 columns past the 77-column pane even before the palette reserve; the pinned 77x47 dump draws 'graph overflows - drag to pan' on line 4. --check also warns that route e0 (cli -> api) and e3 (queue -> worker) have only 2 dot cells, so two hops cannot show motion at all in lr. That is why v1 departs from the recipe's lr preference for five or more stages: at this viewport lr loses two animated hops and the fit.
